records.name: Scholé Scenarios

Scholé Scenarios brings real-world situations into adaptive learning, so you can practice things like explaining what you learned to a teammate, saving a sale, or talking with a client. records.name: Meridian
records.tagline: Don't let your work go unnoticed. Get promoted!

No cloud, no account. MIT-licensed, free.

records.name: Skriptr

records.name: Vendo

Everything for free without any login.

records.name: SimplySee — See it. Understand it.

The tool turns photos into repair estimates and OEM part lists in a few minutes — giving buyers a strong, data-backed starting point for evaluating, repairing a salvage vehicle.

records.name: Text2Test | 0 → Test Suite in Minutes
records.tagline: Turn plain text into automated tests in minutes.

AI testing tools charge you every time tests run. AI helps you create tests, not run them on repeat. Costs scale with what you build, not how often it runs.
